Eden Cortex

## At the research frontier

Frontier AI is the difference between fragmented point solutions and intelligence capable of understanding clinical context, anatomy, modality, and pathology together.

\*Eden Cortex is an investigational device.

Architecture

In production

### Transformer-based, designed for medical imaging

The transformer architecture connects context across the entire study. Eden Cortex brings volumetric data, multiple modalities, and clinical context into a single representation.

Book a Demo

### From pixels and voxels to clinical answers, in seconds.

AI analyzes every study and prepares a personalized report draft before the radiologist opens the case. The radiologist remains the decision maker.

Book a Demo

## The data substrate of frontier diagnostic AI

Eden’s data advantage is structural: the Diagnostic OS generates it continuously, every time a study is processed across our data partners.

medical images

layer curation pipeline

Every study arrives paired with the radiologist's signed report. An 11-layer curation pipeline validates every image before it enters the training corpus.
